features.name: Play a video

actions: use play/pause, the seek bar and the skip controls
rotate the device or tap the fullscreen control for landscape playback

features.name: Edit a photo

actions: choose the tool (crop and rotate, filters, or draw)
choose to overwrite the file or save a copy

actions: pick the aspect ratio or drag the crop handles
use the rotate and flip buttons

actions: tap the filter thumbnail to preview it

features.name: Draw on a photo

actions: pick the brush colour and stroke width

features.name: Resize a photo
features.description: Resize a photo as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: enter the new width and height (the aspect ratio can be locked)

features.name: Rotate a photo without re-encoding
features.description: Rotate a photo without re-encoding as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: choose left, right or 180 degrees; the change is written to the file

features.name: Set a photo as the wallpaper
features.description: Set a photo as the wallpaper as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: select the home screen, lock screen or both

features.name: Share media

choose the destination app from the Android share sheet

features.name: Print a photo

actions: choose the printer or "Save as PDF"

features.name: View media properties
features.description: View media properties as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: read the name, path, size, resolution or duration, date taken, camera details and EXIF data

features.name: Mark media as a favourite

actions: tap the favourite (heart) action; or open it and tap the heart icon. Favourites are collected in a dedicated Favourites folder

features.name: Copy or move media to another folder
features.description: Copy or move media to another folder as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: tap the copy or move icon

features.name: Rename media or a folder
features.description: Rename media or a folder as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: enter the new name (batch renaming with a pattern is offered for multiple selections)

features.name: Delete media
features.description: Delete media as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: confirm; deleted items go to the recycle bin when it is enabled

features.name: Restore or empty the recycle bin
features.description: Restore or empty the recycle bin as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: long-press an item and tap Restore, or tap "Empty the recycle bin"

features.name: Hide a folder from the gallery
features.description: Hide a folder from the gallery as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: confirm; use "Temporarily show hidden" or the settings toggle to see it again

features.name: Exclude a folder from the gallery
features.description: Exclude a folder from the gallery as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: confirm; manage the exclusion list later from Settings

features.name: Pin a folder to the top of the list
features.description: Pin a folder to the top of the list as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: tap the pin action; pinned folders stay at the top of the folder grid

features.name: Create a new folder
features.description: Create a new folder as documented for Fossify Gallery.

features.name: Run a slideshow
features.description: Run a slideshow as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: Open a folder or a photo
set the interval, the animation, whether videos are included and whether it loops randomly

features.name: Search for media
features.description: Search for media as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
type part of the file name
tap a result to open it

features.name: Sort media and folders
features.description: Sort media and folders as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: choose the field (name, date taken, date modified, size, extension or random) and the direction
optionally apply it to the current folder only

features.name: Group media inside a folder
features.description: Group media inside a folder as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: choose none, folder, last modified, date taken, file type or extension
confirm; headers appear between the groups

features.name: Filter the media types shown
features.description: Filter the media types shown as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: tick the types to show (images, videos, GIFs, RAW images, SVGs, portraits)

features.name: Change the grid column count

actions: pinch on the grid to increase or decrease the number of columns, or open the overflow menu
select grid or list and the column count

features.name: Show hidden items
features.description: Show hidden items as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: toggle "Temporarily show hidden" (or enable the permanent setting in Settings)
hidden folders and .nomedia folders become visible

features.name: Open a folder as a home screen shortcut
features.description: Open a folder as a home screen shortcut as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: confirm the placement on the Android home screen

features.name: Fix the "date taken" value of media
features.description: Fix the "date taken" value of media as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: confirm; the EXIF date is written back into the file metadata

features.name: Protect hidden items or the whole app with a lock
features.description: Protect hidden items or the whole app with a lock as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: enable the protection for hidden items, for the recycle bin, for the whole app or for excluded folders

features.name: Customise the app colours and theme
features.description: Customise the app colours and theme as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: choose a preset theme or set the text, background, primary and app-icon colours

features.name: Configure the full-screen viewer behaviour
features.description: Configure the full-screen viewer behaviour as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: toggle options such as hiding the system bars, the swipe-down-to-close gesture, looping through the folder, showing the file name, allowing deep zoom and the double-tap zoom behaviour

features.name: Configure video playback behaviour
features.description: Configure video playback behaviour as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: toggle automatic playback on open, looping, remembering the last playback position and whether the volume/brightness gestures are enabled

features.name: Change the app language and font size
features.description: Change the app language and font size as documented for Fossify Gallery.
actions: tap the Language entry and choose the language
tap the font size entry and choose the size
